name: HD Hyundai Marine Solution CO.,LTD.
summary: HD Hyundai Marine Solution CO.,LTD. provides integrated engineering-based services to Hyundai brand ships. The company also supplies genuine spare parts, and customized parts and services; and provides related technical services, including maintenance and repair, and workshop services. In addition, it offers genuine parts, technical support, and operation and maintenance services for stationary engine power plants. Further, the company engages in the design, installation, and commissioning of retrofit parts, such as scrubbers, BWTS, etc., as well as provides digital control and marine automation solutions, and bunkering and warranty services.
